otp.title: Sign-in code
otp.summary: The six-digit code after Send code. Same email for a new account and for signing back in; only the first line changes.
otp.subject: {{code}} is your /markets code
otp.preheader: It works for 10 minutes. If you didn’t ask for it, ignore this email.
otp.footer: Sent to {{email}} because someone entered it on /markets. We never ask for this code by phone or chat.

variants.label: New account
variants.note: First Send code for this email.

data.lead: Enter this code on /markets to finish signing up.

variants.label: Signing back in
variants.note: The email already has an account.

data.lead: Enter this code on /markets to sign in.

kite-nudge.title: Connect Kite nudge
kite-nudge.summary: Signed up, never connected Kite. Day 1 brings back the question they left waiting; day 3 is the last one and says so.
kite-nudge.subject: {{subject}}
kite-nudge.footer: Sent to {{email}} because you signed up and haven’t connected Kite. {{cap}}

variants.label: Day 1, a question waiting
variants.note: 24 hours after sign-up. Their homepage question is still queued.

data.subject: Your question is waiting for Kite
data.preheader: “Where’s support on Reliance?” runs as soon as Kite is connected.
data.head: Your question hasn’t run yet
data.lead: It needs Kite connected to read prices and charts. Connect once, and it runs straight away.
data.question: Where’s support on Reliance?
data.cap: We send two of these at most.

variants.label: Day 3, the last one
variants.note: 72 hours after sign-up, still not connected. Says it’s the last.

data.subject: Last note about connecting Kite
data.preheader: After this we stop asking. You can connect any time from the sidebar.
data.head: Three things you can ask once Kite is on
data.lead: After this we stop asking. Connect any time from the sidebar.

kite-reconnect.title: Reconnect Kite
kite-reconnect.summary: 08:00 on a trading day, when Kite's 6 AM logout paused watchers. The paused watchers and one Reconnect Kite button. Two mornings in a row at most.
kite-reconnect.subject: {{subject}}
kite-reconnect.preheader: Kite ended your session at 6:00 AM. Reconnect before 9:15 and nothing is missed.
kite-reconnect.footer: Sent to {{email}} only on mornings when Kite has paused your watchers, and two mornings in a row at most.

variants.label: Several paused
variants.note: Five watchers paused. The one the morning flow follows on from.

data.subject: Reconnect Kite to keep 5 watchers running
data.head: Your watchers are paused
data.lead: Kite ends every session at 6:00 AM. Reconnect before 9:15 and they pick up where they left off.
data.after: Each one’s first check after you reconnect sets a new baseline.

variants.label: One paused
variants.note: A new user with the one watcher from their first question.

data.subject: Reconnect Kite to keep your RELIANCE watcher running
data.head: Your RELIANCE watcher is paused
data.lead: Kite ends every session at 6:00 AM, for everyone. Reconnect before 9:15 and it picks up where it left off.
data.after: You’ll do this once a day, on the days you want watchers running.

variants.label: Second morning, the last
variants.note: Not reconnected yesterday either. Says we stop asking.

data.subject: Your RELIANCE watcher stays paused until you reconnect
data.head: We’ll stop asking after today
data.lead: Your watcher has been paused since yesterday at 6:00 AM. It stays paused until you reconnect Kite. We won’t email about it again.
data.after: Paused watchers still end on their end date.

watcher-alert.title: Watcher alert
watcher-alert.summary: A watcher's rule turned true. What hit, the value, a chart with your level, the rule, then Open in chat and Trade on Kite.
watcher-alert.subject: {{sym}} {{said}} · {{value}}
watcher-alert.footer: Facts from market data. Not investment advice. /markets reads data only and never places orders. Sent to {{email}}.

variants.label: Price level
variants.note: GOLDBEES dropped below 100. The one the journey shows.

data.chartAlt: GOLDBEES over the last 12 checks, falling through your level of 100 at 14:05

data.chartAlt: RELIANCE 15-min closes today, the last one below your level of 2,912

watcher-stopped.title: Watcher stopped
watcher-stopped.summary: A watcher's script failed, so it stopped checking. What broke, when, the last good check, and Fix it in chat.
watcher-stopped.subject: Your {{sym}} watcher stopped: {{short}}
watcher-stopped.preheader: It won’t check again until it’s fixed. Fix it in chat hands the error to the agent.
watcher-stopped.footer: Sent to {{email}} once when a watcher stops. Not again for the same error.

variants.label: No data
variants.note: TCS had no candles on 22 Nov. Same watcher as the Stopped one on the Watchers screen.

data.why: There were no daily candles for TCS on 22 Nov, so the script had nothing to check.
data.error: No candles for TCS on 22 Nov
data.hint: Often it’s a holiday or a symbol change.

variants.label: Script error
variants.note: The option chain came back without OI, so the script crashed.

data.why: The option chain for the nearest expiry came back without open interest, and the script failed on it.
data.hint: Nothing was emailed for this rule while it was stopped.

watcher-ended.title: Watcher ended
watcher-ended.summary: A watcher reached its end date. How it went (ran, emails sent, last value) and Watch again. Sent after the close, never during market hours.
watcher-ended.subject: {{subject}}
watcher-ended.footer: Sent to {{email}} when a watcher reaches its end date. Cancelled watchers don’t get one.

variants.label: It hit
variants.note: The RELIANCE watcher from the first question, 30 days on. It hit once.

data.subject: Your RELIANCE watcher ended. It hit once.
data.preheader: 30 days, one email on 25 Nov at 15:00. Watch again for another 30.
data.lead: It ran for 30 days and hit once, on 25 Nov at 15:00, the day you set it.
data.note: Same level, or ask in chat for a new one.

variants.label: Never hit
variants.note: CRUDEOIL ran its full time and never crossed.

data.subject: Your CRUDEOIL watcher ended without hitting
data.preheader: It never closed above 6,480. The closest was 6,471 on 28 Nov.
data.lead: It ran for 30 days and never hit. The closest was a 6,471 close on 28 Nov.
data.note: Or ask in chat where the level is now.

variants.label: Ended while paused
variants.note: Kite was never reconnected, so it spent most of its time paused.

data.subject: Your RELIANCE watcher ended while paused
data.preheader: It was paused from 26 Nov because Kite wasn’t reconnected.
data.lead: It checked for one day. From 26 Nov it was paused, because Kite wasn’t reconnected after the 6:00 AM logout.
data.note: Reconnect Kite first, or it pauses again at 6:00 AM.
